"""A module docstring is a string."""

# Top of the module, above nothing.

import os  # the standard library
# The limit on retries.
LIMIT = 3


# Parses the input.
@staticmethod
def parse(text):
    # Inside the function.
    return text


class Parser:
    """A class docstring is a string."""

    # The source text.
    source = ""

    # Runs the parser.
    def run(self):
        pass  # does nothing

    # Separated from what follows by a blank line.

    def stop(self):
        pass
